rh.number_traceability.prose_claims_cons.reason: The numbers in the prose are macros generated from the logs, but several prose claims built on them are contradicted by those same logs. (a) The Analysis says 'the best model in this entire study is an isotropic compressive scaling of an additive metric on CIE LCh coordinates', which is M1-hcl at chromatic chord held-out LL -1.822. The paper's own appendix table, which it calls 'all four primary configurations', lists models with higher held-out LL on the same chromatic held-out ratings and folds. In arc coordinates: M3-opponent -1.722, M3-hcl -1.756, M2 -1.781. In the joint chord fit: M3-hcl -1.795. In the joint arc fit: M3-opponent -1.686 and M3-ciergb -1.764.
